answer: Cross-epoch behavioural fingerprint rule. Each identity must answer a rotating hidden probe set every epoch; its latency, error, and call-sequence vectors must stay within tolerance of its prior three epochs. A mesa-shaped task rotation blocks memorized answers. Basalt calibration prompts vary difficulty between epochs. Quartz timing probes detect scripted responses. Outliers are quarantined and rewards withheld until three consistent epochs pass. An attacker pays separate sustained compute and latency budgets per identity, plus forfeited rewards during quarantine.
